metadata.agent_last_message:
- Implemented the Node.js 22+ CLI at `output/main.js` (no deps) with:
  - `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`
- Parsing (`output/ics_parser.js`, `output/util.js`) supports unfolding, RFC 6868 parameter decoding, RFC 5545 TEXT unescaping, and emits the required JSON schemas for VCALENDAR + VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VALARM/VAVAILABILITY (plus iTIP METHOD validation warnings).
- Expansion (`output/expand.js`, `output/recurrence.js`, `output/rrule.js`) expands RRULE/RDATE (incl `VALUE=PERIOD`)/EXDATE/EXRULE and applies `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides (incl `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`, orphan handling, and `STATUS:CANCELLED` occurrence emission).
- Timezone resolution (`output/timezone.js`) resolves zoned DTSTARTs strictly from in-file `VTIMEZONE`, including DST fold/gap handling with `timezone_fold_ambiguous` / `nonexistent_local_time` warnings.
